title: OncoDigger Reveals Distinct Cancer-Specific Mutation Landscapes from the Published Literature
description: Curated, reproducible companion repository for the manuscript. Contains the data, analysis scripts, vendored OncoDigger engine source, and manuscript (Markdown + PDF) needed to reproduce every reported number, table and figure, validated against IntOGen (Martinez-Jimenez et al., 2020) as the primary cancer-type driver reference standard.
